messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: elevated 5xx + tail latency observed in us-west-2 for Hosted API and multiple Dedicated pools. Error surface: STS timeouts and CloudWatch ingest errors.

pagerduty: Alert routed to oncall (maria). Incident ID P-2026-221

maria (oncall): Acknowledged. Opening warm bridge and paging infra/SRE. @jonathan @kai please join.

jonathan (infra): On bridge. Grafana shows spike at 08:32 UTC. STS latency jumps and a surge of 502/504s from auth-proxy frontends. Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/egress/usw2

kai (sre): Confirming STS and CloudWatch errors on our egress tier. Token refreshes failing intermittently, p95 token latency up 10x. Logs: `error=504 upstream read timeout`, `GetCallerIdentity timeout`.

felix (support): Receiving inbound support tickets — several customers reporting inference timeouts and request retries. Logging: TKT-8892, TKT-8893. No full outage reported yet.

maria (oncall): Immediate plan: 1) evaluate cross-region routing failover 2) reduce STS dependency via cached sessions 3) communicate to affected customers 4) start handoff plan / assign owners.

kai (sre): Recommended quick mitigations: - enable routing fallback for best-effort requests to us-east-1 - increase auth token cache TTL to reduce STS calls - pause non-essential CloudWatch writes from agents in us-west-2. Runbook ref: infra/runbooks/aws-egress-degradation

jonathan (infra): I'm going to enable routing fallback for non-data-local traffic and roll auth-proxy TTL change in us-west-2. Command: `routectl set-fallback --region=us-west-2 --target=us-east-1 --scope=non-data-local --gradual`

eng-platform-bot: Deploy job queued by jonathan (infra): rolling-restart auth-proxy/us-west-2 (set AUTH_PROXY_TOKEN_TTL=600). Job id deploy-99021.

maria (oncall): Felix please draft a customer blurb noting elevated latency, limited 5xx, and fallback to neighboring region. Mark customers pinned to us-west-2 as potentially impacted.

felix (support): Status page draft posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/P-2026-221. Notifying affected tenants and CS reps.

kai (sre): Early telemetry after enabling fallback: Hosted API 5xx rate down ~55% within 4 minutes. Tail latency improved for synthetic checks. Dedicated pools still showing elevated errors for region-pinned fleets.

jonathan (infra): For Dedicated customers with strict regional pin limits we are compiling list and sending targeted consent request to allow temporary remap to us-east-1. For those who decline, applying token-caching and lowering STS call frequency.

maria (oncall): I'm going to hand the bridge to jonathan for the next 3 hours so I can step away briefly. jonathan, please coordinate mitigations and customer callbacks. I'll rejoin at 11:00 UTC.

jonathan (infra): Taking ownership for the interval. Bridge remains open. Next status update in 15m or on major change.

kai (sre): Action items I'm tracking: 1) full timeline of STS/CloudWatch errors 2) verify no data loss from paused CloudWatch writes 3) measure error rate on Dedicated pools after TTL change.

felix (support): Customer impact log: two mid-tier customers with retries and increased latency; no SLA breach yet. Recording in incident ticket P-2026-221 and creating follow-up CS tasks.

eng-platform-bot: Deploy deploy-99021 succeeded: auth-proxy/us-west-2 rolled, AUTH_PROXY_TOKEN_TTL=600 applied.

jonathan (infra): Post-deploy metrics: STS call rate reduced ~30%, auth proxy error rate down. Observability ingest errors also trending down but not fully recovered.

maria (oncall): Thanks. When stable for 1 hour, we can demote pager and close bridge, then produce a postmortem. Note: please collect traces for a sample of failed requests for RCA.

kai (sre): I'll own the postmortem and collect traces + timeline. Assigning doc id PM-2026-052.

pagerduty: Handoff recorded: maria -> jonathan at 5210003000

jonathan (infra): Bridge remains open for monitoring. I'll coordinate final verification and customer callbacks. If no regressions, we'll close at 5210004800 and transition to postmortem work.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: keep-on-call for 60m.

felix (support): All affected customers notified and tickets updated. Will escalate if any new errors.

maria (oncall): Thanks everyone. Good work on quick mitigation.
